text: FIX attachment ids that are names of `Object.prototype` members (`constructor`, `toString`, `hasOwnProperty`, `valueOf`, `__proto__`) now work like any other attachment id. Before, `getAttachment()` returned a broken RxAttachment instead of `null` for such an id that is not stored, an attachment with the id `__proto__` was dropped without an error, and the Dexie RxStorage returned keys that start with `__` (like the attachment id `__init__.py`) with a leading `|`
